claim: On Tuesday night, 3 November 2026, Bareskrim Polri announced three suspects in an alleged illegal wiretapping case.
The announcement was made by Kabareskrim Komjen (Pol) Asep Safrudin, who quoted the suspects' initials as "LSP, ASN, dan EH".

According to detik, LSP is Listyo Sigit Prabowo; the other two are Irjen Ahrie Sonta and Irjen Eko Hadi Santoso. (Full names attributed to detik only; note detik's body text also writes Ahrie Sonta's initials as 'AHN', inconsistent with the quoted 'ASN'.) kumparan gives the full name Irjen Pol Ahrie Sonta Nasution (ASN); detik's 'AHN' is a typo.
Listyo Sigit Prabowo is a former Kapolri (from 27 Jan 2021) and has been Kepala Staf Kepresidenan since 1 October 2026, replacing Dudung Abdurachman on the day he was replaced as Kapolri.
Per Bareskrim, the suspects are allegedly involved in illegal wiretapping, deletion of electronic data and illegal access; the alleged wiretapping included the President's phone number.
Per police (as reported by detik), other alleged targets included state officials, political figures, media figures, ormas/NGO figures, businesspeople and journalists.
The alleged wiretapping took place in 2025–2026; per Kabareskrim, the wiretap result files were allegedly deleted (ordered deleted from the LIMS system computer) in October 2026.

Per Kabareskrim (reported by kumparan), the three suspects are now detained at Mabes Polri; CNBC Indonesia (4 Nov 06:10, citing AP; article id 20261104013233, full URL missing) also reports their detention.
Suspect status is not a guilty verdict; presumption of innocence applies and a court decides (general legal principle, not a claim about this case's facts).
As of Wednesday morning 4 Nov 2026, no response from Listyo Sigit Prabowo (or a lawyer) had been reported, and the Istana had not commented.

Menko Kumham Imipas Yusril Ihza Mahendra said the government hopes (3 Nov, Kuningan): "Pemerintah berharap seluruh rakyat menaruh kepercayaan kepada Polri" and on Polri investigating Polri: "ya memang sudah jadi tugasnya."
